name: Immersive Music Pack
teaser: An Immersive beep boop pack for the main menu.
description_html:
The dependency for this mod is created by SamSWAT which is included in the download.

This mod adds custom music from various soundtracks that replace the tracks for the main menu.

Call of Duty Modern Warfare 2 (2009), Call of Duty Modern Warfare (2019), Call of Duty Modern Warfare 2 (2022),

Call of Duty Black OPs, Fallout 3, The Callisto Protocol, Detroit: Become Human,

The Last of Us 1 & 2, Sicario, The Dark Knight, Dune, Chainsaw Man, Mass Effect, Tenet

Installation Instructions

  1. Extract the contents of the zip file and drag and drop the “BepInEx” folder to your SPT folder.

If you cannot hear the music, it could be 1 of 2 issues.

  • Remember you need have SamSWAT’s mod, Version 1.1.0 or 1.2.0, installed. Version 1.1.0 is included in this download.
  • Turn up the music setting seen here in the audio settings. Seen here.

Enjoy!
